official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 standards publication date
official_measurement_examples.fact: MHCLG published Approved Documents L and F and Circular 01/2026 on 24 March 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: General commencement date
official_measurement_examples.fact: Circular 01/2026 states the Building Regulations amendments generally come into force on 24 March 2027, subject to transitional provisions.

official_measurement_examples.name: Higher-risk building commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: Specified amendments for higher-risk building work and work to existing HRBs come into force on 24 September 2027.

official_measurement_examples.name: New L3 requirement
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2026 amendments create a new functional requirement L3 for on-site renewable electricity generation for new dwellings and buildings containing dwellings.

official_measurement_examples.name: Earlier standards transition
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document L and F pages state earlier versions continue to apply to buildings subject to previous regulatory standards.

official_measurement_examples.name: RPC rating scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: RPC gave the impact assessments a red rating and explicitly states that the opinion concerns evidence and analysis, not the policy itself.

official_measurement_examples.name: Consultation response date
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Future Homes and Buildings Standards 2023 consultation page records the government response being added on 24 March 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Approved Documents semantics
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Documents provide guidance on ways to meet Building Regulations and do not themselves grant planning permission.
